project.name: Tiresias
project.summary: An evidence-backed 5 Whys root-cause agent for financial analysts: it explains why a company's reported figures changed between SEC filings, discovers the missing evidence, and stops at the first cause the asker can act on.

zetaris.how: The evidence layer: every claim is SQL through Zetaris plus the rows it returned. In live mode every read goes through Zetaris, discovery included: the agent resolves the asked company through a Zetaris SEC tickers table, registers an unknown company's filings at runtime, and in Loop B registers the discovered spun-off entity's filings as a Lightning REST table behind a source gate, then reconciles the restatement. Each Zetaris call is a trace line (SQL, outcome, rows, duration, retries, and the HTTP exchange: endpoint, method, host, status, request and response bytes); a live run from a fresh Zetaris is committed in logs/samples/. The judge's default quickstart is sample mode, which runs the same logic on cached rows.

meterless.how: Nightshift is the model provider for every model call: three lanes (extra hypotheses, a second opinion for the critic, action wording), where the model proposes and the rules and data decide (ADR-0010), chosen per question by investigation depth, quick by default (ADR-0011). A live run from a fresh state at depth deep is committed with every Nightshift call traced (lane, routed_model, provider, receipt id). Every reply is requested as JSON (response_format json_object), and each call's trace line also records the HTTP exchange (endpoint, status, bytes). On Nightshift 1.2.4 a setup can pin the lanes to model ids (METERLESS_MODEL_FAST / METERLESS_MODEL_DEEP). Caveats (docs/sponsor-technology.md#what-the-model-call-trace-shows-and-what-it-does-not): it is one run; sample mode, the judges' default, and depth quick make no model call; in that run the hypothesis lane made no call and one of four replies was unusable and rejected. H-MEM (the Meterless reference engine, vendored unmodified, behind the cognition REST service, conformance 13/13) is the agent's investigation memory in every warm run, sample mode included: entity-free lessons stored behind a memory gate, recalled to reorder the hypothesiser, judged by the critic (helpful / not helpful / wrong feedback), and purgeable through POST /memory/purge (ADR-0005). scripts/memory_demo.py shows cold → warm → misapplied lesson rejected → purge → cold, and runs in CI.

nvidia.how: Nemotron models, served through Meterless Nightshift, power the model lanes: the critic's second opinion (deep lane), extra hypotheses and action wording (fast lane). Every call records the model that actually served it (routed_model) and the receipt id. In the committed fresh-state live run all four calls were served by Nemotron (nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b once, its reply rejected as prose; nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b three times). That run was on Nightshift 1.2.1, which routed on its own; from 1.2.4 (2026-10-26) the lanes can be pinned to Nemotron ids (METERLESS_MODEL_FAST / METERLESS_MODEL_DEEP; the ids are in a .env.example comment, the shipped defaults stay meterless/fast and meterless/deep) and every reply is requested as JSON. Caveats (docs/sponsor-technology.md#what-the-model-call-trace-shows-and-what-it-does-not): one run; the hypothesis lane made no call in it.
